straenge.satz: The rule “A job on a flight starts at on-block at the earliest.” checks the flight number and the on-block of a flight.
Flight Schedule passes the flights (flight number, aircraft type, position, on-block and off-block, status) on to “Staff Dispatch”.
“Flight delay” changes the off-block and the on-block of a flight.
“Tasks move without on-block” changes Flights.
The rule “A task with an agent who lacks the needed qualification stays assigned and is the conflict “Missing qualification”.” checks the qualifications of an agent.
The rule “An agent has at most two tasks per day.” checks Tasks.
The rule “If an agent is absent from a point in time, all their tasks still running after that time are unassigned and stay unassigned.” checks the absence of an agent.
The rule “The same ramp team does unloading and loading of a flight.” checks the team of an agent.
Shifts passes the agents (name, team, qualifications, shift, absence) on to “Staff Dispatch”.
“Conflicts” liest the absence, the qualifications and the shift of an agent.

tagesplan.name: Daily Plan
tagesplan.satz: Each agent has a row in the daily plan, each task is a bar with the flight number.

quelle.wortlaut: You see it in a Gantt chart: each agent has a row, the bars represent a task and show the flight number plus the TODO.
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: Man sieht das in einem Gantt-Chart: Mitarbeiter haben jeweils eine Zeile, die Balken stellen einen Auftrag dar und zeigen die Flugnummer plus das TODO.
quelle.wie: PO's order to Claude Code, verbatim

balkenfarbe.name: Bar colour
balkenfarbe.satz: The colour of a bar shows the job; the legend is above it.

balken-untereinander.name: Bars stacked
balken-untereinander.satz: If an agent's bars overlap, they sit one below the other in the agent's row.

zeitachse.name: Time axis
zeitachse.satz: The time axis runs from the first to the last task of the day, rounded to full hours.

jetzt-linie.name: Current time line
jetzt-linie.satz: A gold line shows the current time in the daily plan.

vor-schicht.name: Before the shift
vor-schicht.satz: Before an agent's shift start, their row is dark.

abwesend-sichtbar.name: Absence in the plan
abwesend-sichtbar.satz: If an agent is absent, their row is striped red from that time, and the reason is shown next to the name.

nicht-zugewiesen.name: Unassigned tasks
nicht-zugewiesen.satz: Tasks without an agent are listed under “Unassigned tasks”, sorted by start.

quelle.wortlaut: All tasks still running after that time are unassigned and listed under “Unassigned tasks”
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: Alle Aufträge, die nach dem Zeitpunkt noch laufen, werden gelöst und liegen unzugewiesen unter „Nicht zugewiesene Aufträge“
quelle.wie: Scope of prototype version 8; chosen by the PO with a click and adopted

niemand-frei.name: Nobody available
niemand-frei.satz: If nobody is available for an unassigned task, it shows “nobody available”.

konfliktzahl.name: Number of conflicts
konfliktzahl.satz: The number of conflicts is shown large next to the plan.

quelle.zusatz: The counter is in the architect's order 001.

konflikt-ueberlappung.name: Overlap
konflikt-ueberlappung.satz: If two tasks of the same person overlap, that is a conflict.

quelle.wortlaut: There must be a conflict list when tasks overlap with others.
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: Es muss eine Konfliktliste geben, wenn sich Aufgaben mit anderen überlappen.
quelle.wie: PO's order to Claude Code, verbatim

konflikt-kapazitaet.name: Capacity gap
konflikt-kapazitaet.satz: If nobody present, qualified and available is found for a task, that is a capacity gap.

quelle.wortlaut: The flight schedule may need more teams than are available.
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: Es kann sein, dass der Flugplan mehr Teams verlangt als verfügbar sind.
quelle.wie: PO's order to Claude Code, verbatim

konflikt-qualifikation.name: Missing qualification
konflikt-qualifikation.satz: If a task is with someone without the right qualification, that is the “Missing qualification” conflict.

quelle.wortlaut: If I drop the bar on an agent without the qualification anyway, it is assigned and a new “Missing qualification” conflict appears in the conflict list.
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: Lasse ich den Balken trotzdem bei einem Mitarbeiter ohne Qualifikation fallen, wird zugewiesen und ein neuer Konflikt „Qualifikation fehlt“ entsteht in der Konfliktliste.
quelle.wie: Scope of prototype version 2; written by the PO himself (his statement of 09.11.2026)

konflikt-anwesenheit.name: Outside presence
konflikt-anwesenheit.satz: If a task is outside its agent's shift or presence, that is a conflict.

quelle.wortlaut: "Task outside presence" is a conflict, counts towards the number on the "Conflict list" tab and is outlined in coral red.
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: "Auftrag außerhalb der Anwesenheit" ist ein Konflikt, zählt in die Zahl am Reiter "Konfliktliste" und wird korallrot umrandet.
quelle.wie: Scope of prototype version 6; worded by the Refiner, changed and adopted by the PO

krankmeldung.name: Sick call
krankmeldung.satz: An agent can be reported sick from a given time.

quelle.wortlaut: Agents must also be able to go sick or be on leave.
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: Es müssen Mitarbeiter auch krank werden dürfen oder Urlaub haben.
quelle.wie: PO's order to Claude Code, verbatim

krank-loest.name: Unassign tasks on sickness
krank-loest.satz: On a sick call, all tasks still running after that time are unassigned.

quelle.wortlaut: All tasks still running after that time are unassigned and listed under “Unassigned tasks”
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: Alle Aufträge, die nach dem Zeitpunkt noch laufen, werden gelöst und liegen unzugewiesen unter „Nicht zugewiesene Aufträge“
quelle.wie: Scope of prototype version 8; chosen by the PO with a click and adopted

zuweisen.name: Assign
zuweisen.satz: A task can be assigned to another agent.

quelle.wortlaut: You must be able to click a bar and say: assign to another agent.
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: Man muss auf einen Balken klicken können und sagen: An einen anderen Mitarbeiter zuweisen.
quelle.wie: PO's order to Claude Code, verbatim

zuweisen-verweigert.name: Assignment without qualification
zuweisen-verweigert.satz: In the starter kit, assigning to someone without the right qualification is refused. Your request 014 changed that.

verschieben.name: Move
verschieben.satz: A task can be moved in time.

quelle.wortlaut: Dragging a bar sideways moves the task in time.
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: Balken waagerecht ziehen verschiebt den Auftrag zeitlich.
quelle.wie: Scope of prototype version 2; written by the PO himself (his statement of 09.11.2026)

kanten.name: Change start and end
kanten.satz: The start and end of a task can be changed separately.

quelle.wortlaut: Dragging the left or right edge changes the start or end.
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: An der linken oder rechten Kante ziehen ändert Beginn oder Ende.
quelle.wie: Scope of prototype version 2; written by the PO himself (his statement of 09.11.2026)

mindestdauer.name: Minimum duration
mindestdauer.satz: A task takes at least 5 minutes.

quelle.wortlaut: The same rules apply as for dragging, including that a task is at least 5 minutes long.
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: Es gelten dieselben Regeln wie beim Ziehen, auch dass ein Auftrag mindestens 5 Minuten lang ist.
quelle.wie: Scope of prototype version 10; worded by Claude, adopted by the PO in the chat on 30.09.

flugplan.name: Flight Schedule
flugplan.satz: There is a flight schedule for the day.

quelle.wortlaut: There is a flight schedule for the day.
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: Es gibt einen Flugplan für den Tag.
quelle.wie: PO's order to Claude Code, verbatim

arbeiten.name: Jobs on the flight
arbeiten.satz: The jobs on the flights are unloading, loading, lavatory service, fuelling and cabin cleaning.

quelle.wortlaut: The following jobs must be done on every flight: loading and unloading, lavatory service, fuelling, cabin cleaning.
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: An jedem Flug müssen folgende Arbeiten erledigt werden. Be- und Entladen, Fäkalien entleeren, Betanken, Cleaning des innenraums.
quelle.wie: PO's order to Claude Code, verbatim

qualifikationen.name: Qualifications
qualifikationen.satz: Each job needs its own qualification; each agent has their qualifications.

quelle.wortlaut: Each job needs its own qualification.
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: Für jeden Job braucht man eine eigene Qulifikation.
quelle.wie: PO's order to Claude Code, verbatim

schichten.name: Shifts
schichten.satz: Each agent has a shift start and a shift end.

quelle.wortlaut: Shift data: every agent has a shift start and a shift end.
quelle.wortlautDeutsch: Schichtdaten: Jeder Mitarbeiter hat Schichtstart und Schichtende.
quelle.wie: Scope of prototype version 5; written by the PO himself (his statement of 09.11.2026)

geaendert.satz: For this, the step from Started back to Open is now allowed, also in the status menu on the bar.
For this, the step from Done back to Open is now allowed, also in the status menu on the bar.
